details: Generate a screenshot image with detailed float information for a specific item in CS:GO or CS2.
The float data is retrieved using the provided inspect link.
The response streams the generated image directly to the client.
Supports custom backgrounds, logos, and color schemes for branding.
Can return image as PNG stream, base64 string, or download format.
usage_notes: Provide the item's inspect link using the `url` parameter.
Use `as_base64=1` for easier integration when you need base64 format.
Customize appearance with color schemes and custom backgrounds/logos.
Set `format=download` to trigger browser download of the image.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The inspect link of the item. Example: steam://rungame/730/....

parameters.name: as_base64
parameters.description: Set to 1 to return the image as a base64 string. Default is 0, base64 is sometimes helpful for easier integration.

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Color scheme for the screenshot. Options: black, blue, green, orange, purple, red, white, yellow, gray.

parameters.name: background_url
parameters.description: Custom background image URL (PNG format). Overrides default background.

parameters.name: logo_url
parameters.description: Custom logo image URL (PNG format). Overrides default logo.

parameters.name: logo_offset_start
parameters.description: Logo start position. Options: top left, top right, bottom left, bottom right.

parameters.name: logo_width
parameters.description: Width of the logo in pixels (Max: 500).

parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Send a format - screen (default) for show, download for download the image, base64 for base64 image.

responses.description: The image has been successfully generated and streamed to the client.
